intro.text: A Rosharan land that was once part of the Silver Kingdom of Makabakam.
A nation of south-central Roshar, lying between the Tarat Sea and the mountains that hold Urithiru, with Marat and Tu Fallia on either side.

description.text: A largely bleak, windswept plain with few rockbuds. Its ground is creased by shallow cuts that give it a rippled look, with lichen on the side facing the storms and grass pressed flat on the lee side. The few trees are thin and bent nearly to the ground, and the mountaintops are stripped bare. The Valley of the Nightwatcher lies in the mountains along its northwestern border.

Most Hexi live as nomads, and a traveller may go days without coming across a village. They wear their hair in braids, and are mostly quiet people with little interest in other nations' affairs. Hexi is seen as a backwater, more so even than neighbouring Marat.
The Hexi can be hard to trade with. Those who speak respectfully may receive gifts, but arrogant traders are refused outright. After trading with Rysn, they departed singing a farewell.
The Hexi faith keeps animals as sacred, and its priests swear never to eat meat. Grubs and insects count as plants, not animals.
Because grubs count as plants, fresh grain with worms in it is a prized food.
Jerky from dead animals is made solely for trade with outsiders.

The Hexi can be hard to trade with. Those who speak respectfully may receive gifts, but arrogant traders are refused outright. After trading with Rysn, they departed singing a farewell.

In 1168, Dalinar took a small group of soldiers into Hexi on his way to seek the Nightwatcher, travelling with a caravan until they were close to the Valley.
